findings.cause: BrowserTab.setupCommitTracking is fire-and-forget from the constructor; on a tab navigated right after creation, the main frame id (Page.getFrameTree) is not yet known when Network.responseReceived(Document) arrives, so the Document response is dropped (browser-tab.ts responseReceived handler: `if (!this.lastMainFrameIdForCommitTracking || frameId !== ...) return;`). Page.frameNavigated then sets lastMainFrameCommitAt, so runtime.audit current-page mode scopes the ring buffer from the commit instant, excluding the pre-commit ring-buffer copy of the same response. Own-status fallback order is live capture (null) -> goto fallback (url mode only) -> ring-buffer URL match against page.url(), which fails for exactly GAP-273's shapes.
findings.introducedBy: escalation-1 (GAP-278 fix: commit-time scoping in current-page mode); not changed by escalation-2; missed by audit-5 and escalation-2's scoped re-verification (its probes always visited a page before the audited one)
findings.mitigation: Chrome's own generic 'Failed to load resource' console error is still in consoleErrors (nConsole=1), exactly like GAP-267's profile; audit({url}) mode is unaffected (85/85).
findings.blockedDiagnosis: Current-page own-status depends on a SECOND, lazily attached, fire-and-forget CDP session (BrowserTab.setupCommitTracking) whose readiness races the tab's first navigation, while escalation-1's commit-time scoping removes the ring-buffer copy of the same response; any miss is recoverable only by the fragile page.url() match GAP-273 already condemned. Needed change (architectural, not a patch): make one authoritative per-tab document record that exists from tab construction -- e.g. key the main-document response by the navigation's loaderId (CDP requestId==loaderId for navigations) from the tab's own synchronously-attached Puppeteer listeners (which already log the response with resourceType) and bind it to the committed loaderId, OR have BrowserTab.navigate() await the bounded tracking setup before goto and let current-page mode use goto's own response when the last commit came from navigate(). Gate the capture on the committed loaderId at read time as well (also fixes A6-3).

gap285Judgment: Residual is real, narrow and honestly characterized: restored page's own pre-restore 404 kept 0/15 runtime, 0/15 MCP; coversWholeDocument false 15/15 + 15/15 on every restore; no foreign findings; own console error usually kept (13/15, 14/15). No false-negative regression: coversWholeDocument true on every ordinary audit shape (7 shapes x 15). Adjacent: A6-4.
point5Judgment: Not sufficient. audit-6 re-ran the audit-1..5 surface (a1 runtime/cli/sdk-schema/l12, a2 gap262/cli/mcp-sdk-dialogs/vitals/ajv, a3 runtime all+heavy/cli sweep/fine/shapes/concurrent/own404/snap/real-docstatus, a4/a5 273x/hang-fresh/tablife/gap278/a51-mcp) and everything held, identical to audit-5 (except the 1/80 A6-2 flake). But a 3-mode re-run of audit-4's 17 GAP-273 shapes (url / current-page on a fresh tab / current-page after a prior navigation) found A6-1: every escalation-2 and audit-5 probe navigated the tab at least once before the audited page, so the fresh-tab current-page path was never exercised.
